title: 港股收评：恒指跌1.27% 科指跌2.04% 科网股普跌 智谱跌超10%
summary: 9月10日港股全线下跌，恒生指数跌1.27%报24954.47，恒生科技指数跌2.04%；美团、百度跌逾3%，应用软件板块跌幅居前，智谱跌超10%；内银股逆势走强，民生银行涨超3%。
why: 港股科网股整体承压，持仓腾讯、美团、阿里等标的均受拖累；科技指数跌幅超大盘，隐含波动率可能上行，对已持有港股期权仓位需留意行权风险。

title: 收评：三大股指集体收跌 全市场超4500只个股下挫
summary: 9月10日A股三大指数全线收跌，沪指跌0.43%报3934.40，深成指跌0.77%，创业板指跌0.49%，两市下跌个股逾4500只。银行股逆势全线上涨，南京银行、宁波银行涨超2%，多家银行股创历史新高；电力板块亦活跃，华银电力等多股涨停。20家A股上市银行披露中期分红预案，合计拟派现约2661亿元。
why: A股宽幅调整，市场情绪偏弱，科技/消费赛道被整体压制；银行股创历史新高显示防御性资金轮动明显，对A股持仓的波动率判断需结合整体市场情绪。

title: Oil Nears $100 as Markets Assess Fed Rate Expectations and Iran Tensions
summary: Brent crude climbed to $97.19/bbl as the US and Iran exchanged direct military fire in the Strait of Hormuz. Strong August US payrolls (162K vs. 53K expected) add pressure toward a rate hike at the Sept 15-16 FOMC meeting. Fed Governor Waller said he is inclined to support holding rates at 3.50%-3.75%, while oil's inflation pass-through sharpens hike risks.
why: 油价逼近$100及潜在美联储加息共同压制风险资产估值；对sell put策略而言，整体IV抬升有利于期权权利金收入，但标的跌破行权价风险需评估；霍尔木兹风险若升级或进一步推升能源通胀，影响持续。

title: Nvidia at Goldman Sachs Conference Sept. 10: Vera Rubin Production Begins, CPU Market Entry
summary: Nvidia presented at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on Sept 10. The company confirmed its Vera Rubin AI platform has begun production shipments and is expected to contribute ~20% of data center revenue in Q3. Nvidia also enters the standalone CPU market with Rubin, directly challenging AMD and Intel in another segment.
why: Vera Rubin量产确认是英伟达Q3数据中心收入的重大催化剂；进军CPU市场具长期增量意义；SK海力士作为70%的HBM4供应商将同步受益；持仓NVDA者需注意利好兑现后的期权隐含波动率回落效应。

title: Intel Stock Jumps 9% on Chip Price Hike Report, US Stake Gains $36 Billion
summary: Intel (INTC) surged 9.05% on Sept 8, closing at $104.47, driven by: a planned 10% PC processor price hike effective Oct 5 (third hike this year); Intel and ASML confirming over 1 million wafers run through High-NA EUV machines (critical foundry milestone); and a Northland Securities upgrade to Outperform with $120 target.
why: 英特尔三连涨价策略转向利润保护，High-NA EUV百万片里程碑实质推进代工转型；这是英特尔复苏叙事的重要验证，可能支撑较高行权价的期权布局；与英伟达/AMD竞争态势重新分化值得关注。

title: Palantir Climbs 8% Amid Army Contract Win and Expanded PwC AI Alliance
summary: Palantir (PLTR) surged ~8% Thursday Sept 10, its best single-day gain in a month, driven by an expanded PwC US strategic AI alliance — including an industry-first AI-native M&A platform on Foundry/AIP — plus a new US Army contract. The rally reverses Wednesday's 7% drop triggered by Google's Fairwind Program (Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber for government AI).
why: PLTR企业侧扩张（PwC M&A+ERP平台）是减少对政府客户集中依赖的关键信号；Google Fairwind竞争威胁短期引发波动，但目前未实质损伤PLTR客户群；对PLTR的sell put而言，高波动率短期对权利金有利，但需留意Google后续的政府AI渗透速度。

title: Memory Runs Dry: Samsung and SK Hynix Drop Below 10-Day Supply as HBM4 Devours Capacity
summary: Samsung and SK Hynix have fallen below 10 days of finished DRAM inventory as HBM4 production for Nvidia's Vera Rubin consumes 3× conventional DRAM wafer capacity. SK Hynix holds ~70% of Nvidia's HBM4 orders; 16-Hi HBM4 (48GB/cube) is now in customer qualification for Q4 2026, with Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron all certified as Vera Rubin HBM4 suppliers.
why: 延续报道：Vera Rubin供应链持续紧张。HBM4供应告急利好SK海力士（及南方两倍做多ETF），普通DRAM产能被挤占可能推高DRAM现货价，美光作为认证供应商具同向受益逻辑。

title: Google's Fairwind Program: Cyber Defense AI Tools for Trusted Government Partners
summary: Google launched the Fairwind Program, offering Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber — restricted exclusively to government authorities, critical infrastructure operators, and vetted software partners. The capabilities directly overlap with Palantir's core federal/defense AI offerings and triggered a ~7% PLTR sell-off before Thursday's recovery.
why: 谷歌以Gemini 3.8 Flash直接进入政府AI市场，是PLTR中期最大竞争威胁之一；短期市场已对此定价后反弹，中期需追踪Fairwind计划的实际合同落地速度；对谷歌（GOOGL）持仓则是积极信号，显示其AI商业化拓展至高利润政府市场。
